#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

void appendMissing(string &sb, int a) {
    set<char> s;
    int start = max(0, (int)sb.length() - a);
    for (int i = sb.length() - 1; i >= start; i--) {
        s.insert(sb[i]);
    }
    int op = a;
    for (int i = 0; i < 26 && op > 0; i++) {
        char c = 'a' + i;
        if (s.find(c) == s.end()) {
            sb.push_back(c);
            op--;
        }
    }
}

void appendLast(string &sb, int b) {
    char ch = sb.back();
    for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
        sb.push_back(ch);
    }
}

int main() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;

    string fin;
    for (int i = 0; i < a; i++) {
        fin.push_back('a' + i);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
        fin.push_back('a' + a - 1);
    }

    int x = l % (a + b);
    if (x == 0) x = a + b;
    if (x > 1) {
        fin.erase(0, x - 1);
    }

    appendMissing(fin, a);
    appendLast(fin, b);
    appendMissing(fin, a);
    appendLast(fin, b);

    set<char> distinct;
    for (int i = 0; i <= r - l && i < (int)fin.length(); i++) {
        distinct.insert(fin[i]);
    }
    cout << distinct.size() << endl;

    return 0;
}
